about.heading: About
about.intro: Tbarak Spinning and Weaving Company strives to provide premium-quality raw materials and fabrics at the most competitive prices.
about.item1: We provide reliable fabrics with consistent quality and regular shipping.
about.item2: We build long-term partnerships with trusted suppliers.
about.item3: We maintain ready stock to support uninterrupted production.
about.item4: We understand the local market and deliver fast, flexible solutions.

process.heading: How We
process.step1Body: We rely on the finest types of structures and fibers, carefully selected, and the highest levels of performance and stability within the range of use.
process.step2Body: We rely on the finest types of yarns and fibers, carefully selected, to ensure the highest levels of performance and stability in manufacturing and long-term use.
process.step3Body: We use state-of-the-art circular knitting machines along with innovative technologies to ensure the production of high-quality fabrics that meet the highest standards of comfort, durability and beauty.
